summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held June 25, 2026, where shareholders approved the election of six director nominees and re-appointment of auditors. The filing is a routine meeting outcome report under Canadian corporate law, mapped to a US equivalent of a Form 8-K Item 5.07 disclosure. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change—is present. The directors were elected with votes ranging from 85% to 99.86% in favor. No deal terms, price, premium, or advisor are mentioned. This is a routine corporate governance filing.
